subject: Request: one-time top-up for Alpha cohort & pricing-floor exemption
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice@alphahub.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-08T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Alpha Batch 2 - emergency top-up request

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note from AlphaHub — our Alpha Batch 2 cohort has ramped far faster than our projections and we've hit the free-credits bucket for the demo users. We have about ~150k token demand forecasted over the next 30 days but only ~95k credits left.

Would Redwood consider a one-time top-up (50k token-equivalent) and a temporary waiver of the standard pricing floor so we can keep the pilot live and convert a subset of teams to paid Dedicated later? If possible we need a quick yes/no by EOD Monday to avoid pausing the cohort next week.

I've attached the usage export and a short note from our engineering lead on expected load (devops@alphahub.co CC'd).

Context that may help: this pilot includes 6 teams (internal tools + two external testers) and the conversion motion looks strong — we expect to pilot a paid proof-of-concept in Q1 if we can avoid an interruption.

Thanks for any fast guidance — appreciate it.

Best,
Alice Moreno
Head of Accelerator, AlphaHub
attachments: alpha_batch2_usage_Q4.csv

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-12-08T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Alpha Batch 2 - emergency top-up request

Ben / Laura — forwarding a request from AlphaHub (attached). Short ask: one-time top-up of 50k token-equivalent and a temporary pricing-floor exception so they can keep the pilot running. They asked for an answer by EOD Monday.

My thoughts: this looks like a high-conversion cohort and the ask is small relative to potential ARR if they convert. If we approve, I'd like to tie the top-up to a short MOU (agree to conversion check-ins, fact-based usage milestones) and a firm commit to a paid POC by March.

Can you two weigh in on: 1) commercial risk/exposure 2) potential routing (promo credit vs invoice one-time top-up) 3) what minimal paperwork we need to waive the pricing-floor for this cohort.

Attaching their usage export.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz\Head of Growth Programs
Redwood Inference
attachments: alpha_batch2_usage_Q4.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-08T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Alpha Batch 2 - emergency top-up request

On Wed, Dec 8, 2027 at 11:02 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben / Laura — forwarding a request from AlphaHub (attached). Short ask: one-time top-up of 50k token-equivalent and a temporary pricing-floor exception so they can keep the pilot running.

Thanks for looping me in. Quick take: I prefer the invoice top-up route (one-off, non-refundable) rather than applying promo credits — that keeps accounting clean and avoids setting a promo precedent. Also recommend a short term cap and a staged release: 25k tokens now, additional 25k after they confirm a scheduled conversion call and share the POC plan (a one-page plan).

Rough numbers: if they convert to Dedicated at standard startup discount, our exposure on the 50k tokens is minimal relative to forecasted ARR. If we waive the pricing floor, I'd like a condition that the waiver expires automatically at the end of the pilot window (90 days) unless they sign a POC addendum.

I'll draft a quick pricing-impact estimate and suggested MOU (see attached). Laura — can finance process a one-line invoice for a top-up with net-7 and tag it as non-refundable promo coverage? If not, what's the clean alternative?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: pricing-impact-estimate.xlsx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@alphahub.co>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-09T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Alpha Batch 2 - emergency top-up request — approved with conditions

Alice — good news, we can support a one-time top-up of 50k token-equivalent and a temporary pricing-floor exemption for Alpha Batch 2 with the following conditions: 

- Payout structure: Invoice-based one-time top-up (non-refundable). 25k tokens invoiced and released immediately; additional 25k released after AlphaHub completes a brief POC plan and a scheduled conversion review call (within 30 days).
- Timebox: Waiver applies only for a 90-day pilot window starting 2027-12-09; pricing-floor protections automatically resume after that period unless a POC addendum is signed.
- Requirements: Signed MOU that captures the above conditions + two scheduled check-ins (30d and 75d) and an opt-in to our conversion assistance program.

Laura — can you create the invoice (tag: ALPHA-2027-009-TOPUP) and loop Finance for net-7 terms? I've attached a draft MOU for your review (mou-alpha-topup-draft.pdf).

Ben — thanks for the suggested staged release; we'll follow that. I'll send a short MOU link to Alice after Laura confirms invoicing cadence.

Alice — if that works, please confirm and I'll send the MOU link and invoice next. Appreciate the quick turnaround — we want to keep the cohort live.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Growth Programs
Redwood Inference
attachments: mou-alpha-topup-draft.pdf
